name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 7 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2026-07-06, at wavelengths from 0.81 to 4.54 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
